|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/endorchiefchirpashut.html</ref>

Like the Ewok Village, this is another safe haven for our furry Ewok friends. Any place away from the lurking presence of Imperial Speeder Bikes and AT-STs is a good place. Your Ewoks come out easily here if you need to battle to hold this location, but if you want to move them elsewhere on [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] it's not really worth deploying them here first (as the 1 Force you save in deploy you will use in movement). This can be justified if you can throw them onto a vehicle.

As the name obviously suggest, getting [[Chief Chirpa]] here is useful in a force restricted game. His ability to find Ewoks from Reserve is invaluable if your hairy horde is to repel the Imperial invaders early. This is also a good place to protect him away from the terrors of [[Speeder Bike]] Cannons and Tramples. In a [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Booster Draft environment, grab this if you can get it. This location, [[Careful Planning]] and the Ewok Village is the best start your Ewok deck can get.

Card Combos:

If ever any Imperial trouble makes it into the Village, your Sentries will react for free to help out the Chief. And on your turn, use the Chief to get whatever non-unique Ewok you need most (e.g. [[Ewok Tribesman]] or [[Ewok Spearman]]).
